name: as.yearmon
title: An Index Class for Monthly Data

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric, Date, POSIXt, character, factor, or yearqtr value.
Arguments passed to the method. Character input takes format. A yearqtr takes frac.

origin.details: The default method coerces with as.numeric first. Character input uses one format for the whole vector. With format omitted, zero hyphens means %B %Y, one hyphen means %Y-%m, and any other count means %Y-%m-%d. A format made only of %m, %b, %B, %y, %Y, and %% is read as the first of that month. POSIXt is converted in GMT. frac on a yearqtr is the fraction of the quarter, and 0 keeps the yearqtr number.
origin.value: A numeric vector of class yearmon.
origin.example:
x <- as.yearmon(c("Mar 2007", "January 2000", "December 1999"))
cat(paste(sprintf("%.17g", as.numeric(x)), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
cat(paste(format(x), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
cat(sprintf("%.17g\n", as.numeric(as.yearmon("mar07", "%b%y"))))
cat(paste(format(as.yearmon("2007-03-01")), format(as.yearmon("2007-12")), sep = " "), "\n", sep = "")

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A number, string, date, datetime, Yearmon, or Yearqtr.

arguments.name: format
arguments.text: strptime format for character input. An empty string picks %B %Y, %Y-%m, or %Y-%m-%d from the number of hyphens.

arguments.name: frac
arguments.text: Fraction through a Yearqtr. Zero keeps the yearqtr's numeric value.

translation.details: Numbers go through yearmon. Integers keep their numeric value and are not snapped. Strings are parsed in English month names, case ignored, and a short format is read as the first of the month. A datetime is converted to UTC before the month is read. chron, timeDate, mondate, and tis classes raise TypeError.
translation.example:
from zoo.yearmon import as_yearmon, format_yearmon
x = as_yearmon(["Mar 2007", "January 2000", "December 1999"])
print(" ".join(format(v, ".17g") for v in x.value))
print(" ".join(format_yearmon(x)))
print(format(float(as_yearmon("mar07", "%b%y").value[0]), ".17g"))
print(format_yearmon(as_yearmon("2007-03-01"))[0], format_yearmon(as_yearmon("2007-12"))[0])
